create_f1_score_metric: create an F1Score metric to evaluate object detection model predictions against ground truth detections
run_f1_score_update_compute: run F1Score metric by updating with predictions and targets then computing the result
test_f1_score_with_masks: test the F1Score metric with metric_target set to MetricTarget.MASKS for segmentation evaluation
summarize_f1_score_result: summarize the F1ScoreResult object by accessing f1_50 and f1_75 properties
review_f1_score_result_plot: review the F1ScoreResult by calling plot() to visualize F1 scores by object size
